verdict.rationale: Rive is a cloud-hosted editor with a built-in AI agent and MCP integration, so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents an AI-training data policy, an opt-out control, or any data-use commitment. The AI agent, MCP, and revision-history docs describe features, not training-data protections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
